description: This file is a shell script that exercises testing of multi-pack bitmap functionality in a Git-like version control system. It includes setup, test cases, and validation steps for features related to bitmap indexing, pack reuse, and integrity checks.

methods.name: bitmap_reuse_tests
methods.description: Sets up and runs tests for reusing bitmaps across different pack configurations, verifying bitmap correctness after pack manipulations.

methods.name: test_midx_bitmap_cases
methods.description: Executes a series of tests with different bitmap configurations, including setup, failure cases, and snapshot handling.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Utility to corrupt a file's contents to test checksum validation failure handling.
